claims.verbatim:
Ship Ellen Austin, French, Liverpool Aug 3[?], with mdse
and 60[?] passengers, to Spofford, Tileston & Co. Had strong
head winds the entire passage; split sails, &c. Aug 16[?], lat
46[?] 55[?], lon 18[?] 30[?], signalized ship Oliver Cromwell (Br), from
Rangoon, steering E; same time, signalized a ship showing
Marryatt's 3d[?] pendant, 9625[?], steering E; same day, in lat
46[?] 30[?], lon 20[?] 05[?], signalized ship Florence[?], steering ENE[?]. Has
anchored at Quarantine. [cut]

claims.citation: New York Herald, 18 September 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Palmyra (Br), Watson, Liverpool, Sept 4, and
Queenstown 5th, with mdse and 448 passengers, to E
Cunard. Sept 4, 5:35 PM, passed ship S Curling, from St
John, NB, bound in; 9th, lat 50 6 N, lon 30 32 W, passed
ship Java, bound W; 12th, lat 47 38, lon 56, passed steamship
City of New York, hence for Liverpool; 16th, lat 42 40, lon
65[?] 13, passed ship Ellen Austin, from Liverpool for New
York.
